groups.note: SWEPT, with its declared magnet__R0 tie (ANNEX section Declared ties; tie data in manifest.json). Plasma major radius, the wall half's geometry lever. Its effect on the wall load at this pin is the OPEN MEASUREMENT goal.md section Invariants names: in the average wall load R cancels exactly at fixed (n, T, a) -- p_fus is proportional to R through the volume and the circular-torus wall area is proportional to R -- so any R response of the wall load comes only through the WI-037 sustainment state (ISS04 tau_E ~ R^0.64 with B_axis ~ I_coil / R at fixed current, feeding the converged ash and fuel densities and so p_fus). R reaches the field fences through B_axis ~ 1/R and the magnet cost through the winding length. The pre-WI-037 constancy in R (20260829-p-pump-fence) does not transfer and is not assumed.

SWEPT, with a window that BRACKETS the committed a >= 1.70 violation (20260829-p-pump-fence: wall_load_ok violated at every a >= 1.70 at that pin, on the average fence). Plasma minor radius. The average wall load scales as a^2 / (a + 0.10) at fixed (n, T) -- more plasma per unit of first-wall area as a grows -- so under the honest fence (the peak = average x 1.316441) the baseline a = 1.3 already reads 4.088 against 4.05, and the a-boundary is expected BELOW 1.3 at the baseline density and temperature, while ISS04 confinement (tau_E ~ a^2.28) pulls the sustainment boundary the other way. The a-direction is where the deadlock between the two fences is expected to be sharpest. CRITIQUE F2/F3: nothing bounds a from above in the model -- no aspect-ratio, coil-space or shaping fence, no ash-fraction bound, and the Sudo density limit (a surfaced gap) falls with a while n_e0 is held; the magnet account is blind to a (winding length k_coil x R0, held casing mass); and the sign of the wall load's a-response is set by the held transport facts tau_ratio_ash x f_suppr_ash and iota_23, carried from the design point. All disclosed; the transect arm measures the first.

SWEPT. Peak electron density; the fuel peaks are computed from it by quasi-neutrality with the converged ash, and the line-averaged ISS04 density derives from it. The strongest wall lever (p_fus ~ n^2 at fixed T); the window reaches the beta limit so beta_ok is testable, and reaches below 0.9x so recirc_ok is testable (round 1 caught 0.8x by recirc_ok).

SWEPT, interior or fence-caught, past 18 keV where the scan shows anything (20260903-priced-levers#5; goal.md section Invariants). Peak ion temperature; T_e0 rides the held 0.95 ratio inside the sustainment calc. Temperature relieves sustainment and loads the wall; round 1 found the 220 MW optimum interior at 16 keV and nothing feasible above 18 keV at either level under the average fence.

SWEPT, under the conductor ceiling. Peak single-coil current, the field lever; B_axis ~ I_coil / R, so with R swept the field fences are reached along a diagonal, and the ceiling (24.9 T) is reached at a different current at each R. Since WI-036 it also sizes the winding pack and reaches the conductor strain check.

SWEPT as SENSITIVITY at two levels, not searched: 100 MW (the printed 50 MW coupled at the held eta_source 0.50 and eta_couple 1.00) and 220 MW (110 MW coupled), the two levels every study on this package since 20260901-sustainment-fence has reported. No tie: since WI-039 both the heating account and the coupled power descend from this one key through the chain.

DECLINED, traced, HELD at 0.50. Round 1 answered this axis (learnings L-001 and L-002: at the printed level the escape is not source efficiency; whether efficiency pays depends on what is held) and the round-1 review carried 'source efficiency held at 0.50' into round 2's strategy. Sweeping it here would confound the wall question with the answered heating one.

DECLINED, traced, held at its disclosed 1.00 -- degenerate with eta_source_heat in the sustainment fence (they enter only as their product), and the OPTIMISTIC end of the stated deposition assumption: every feasibility claim in this study is made at the most generous possible coupling (round 1 F6; the WI-039 grader's EI note).

DECLINED, traced, held at 118.8271604938272. Winding-pack current density; checked inert in round 1 (critique F7: a 53% swing moves LCOE by 0.03% and moves B_peak, wall load and p_aux_required not at all). Held and asserted per case.

DECLINED, traced. The conductor peak-field ceiling: a pure fence-relaxer as bound, still unpriced (WI-038 is its vehicle, sequenced after this goal's wall half and after WI-040). Sweeping it would manufacture feasible points that cost nothing.

DECLINED, traced, HELD by definition -- the source anchor of the WI-041 calibration (the printed 4.05 MW/m^2 peak at 2700 MW, Table 2 image), one of six reference facts (with p_fus_ref, R_ref, a_ref, kappa_ref, standoff_ref) that fix the calibration at the source's design point. It is a source fact, not a design lever; sweeping it would be tuning the disclosed baseline verdict. The calibration's SENSITIVITY is the shadow column's job instead: points.csv carries the peak re-read at the round-1 external band (net 1.15x and 1.83x on the average, the shaped-wall route of T-001 round 1) beside the executed fence, so the choice of anchor is data.

SWEPT as a SENSITIVITY TRANSECT through an ASSUMPTION, not a design lever (scope amendment 2026-09-04; critique F2). The particle-to-energy confinement-time ratio tau*/tau_E, a Stellaris Table-4 fact (8.0) at a = 1.3, A = 9.8. With the WI-037 converged ash balance it sets, with f_suppr_ash, how much helium accumulates and so how fast the fuel dilutes as confinement improves with a -- the mechanism behind the wall load FALLING with a past 1.3 at this pin, which is the reading that opens the printed level. The critique showed the sign flips at tau*/tau_E = 4 (the peak RISES with a; no 100 MW point survives) and sustainment closes at 16. Swept 2/4/6/12/16 through three anchors (15 points); every other arm holds 8.0 and asserts it per case. Framed sensitivity; no boundary claim.

DECLINED, traced, held at 0.50. The helium suppression heuristic (Stellaris Table 4). It enters the ash balance only in the product f_suppr_ash x tau_ratio_ash, so the tau_ratio_ash transect delivers its whole sensitivity (critique F2: tau*/tau_E = 4 and f_suppr = 0.25 are identical).

DECLINED, traced, held at 0.92. The rotational transform at two-thirds radius in the ISS04 scaling, a Stellaris configuration fact at the design point. The critique probed it: at 0.70 the scan's best 100 MW point reads 4.512 (violated), at 1.10, 3.643. A configuration property of the QI shape, not a design lever the model can re-optimise; held, and named as one of the three design-point transport facts the a-reversal is conditional on.
